description: This file defines configuration options and validation logic for Redis-based reminder tables in Orleans. It includes a class for storing Redis client options, a method for creating Redis connections, and a validator class to ensure proper configuration.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration settings for Redis, including connection options and a factory method for creating Redis connection instances.

classes.name: RedactRedisConfigurationOptions
classes.description: Custom redaction attribute class to mask sensitive Redis configuration details.

classes.name: RedisReminderTableOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the Redis reminder table options to ensure necessary configurations are provided.

methods.name: DefaultCreateMultiplexer
methods.description: Default factory method to asynchronously create and connect a Redis connection multiplexer using specified configuration options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation on the Redis reminder options to ensure required fields are set.
